data_fields.name: playerActionTimeoutSec
data_fields.donor_constant: per game config, read at servergamestate.cpp:1643; 0 means no timer

best_idea: Check each client action in a fixed order (stale round, then wrong actor, then the rule), change nothing on reject, and reply with a reason code; a malformed frame is a separate tier that closes the session.
decision_why: Keep the order, reason codes, no-change-on-reject and timeout default; do not copy the rewrite of the client intent before the check, because the reject then echoes a value the client never sent.
acceptance: A server test sends a stale-round action, an action from the non-acting player and an illegal raise; each gets a reject with the matching code, the fight state is unchanged, and a schema-invalid frame closes the session.
